eu_region.description: The SurveyMonkey account region. Specify `true`, if your account is hosted in the EU region. Default value is `false`.

access_token.description: The long-lived `Access token` carries the information necessary to access API resources.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your SurveyMonkey client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your SurveyMonkey client application.
